title: 10 Best Tussilago Farfara Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Tussilago farfara are teas, decoctions, syrups, linctuses, and lozenges, each designed to harness its soothing and expectorant properties. Teas made from dried leaves are commonly used to relieve coughs and respiratory irritation. Decoctions, which involve boiling the herb, are often preferred for their stronger potency. Syrups and linctuses provide a more palatable and concentrated form, making them suitable for children and adults alike. Lozenges offer a convenient way to deliver the herb’s benefits directly to the throat, aiding in the relief of soreness and congestion.
